Definition: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of the alternate of G2192; properly, loitering (as a withholding of oneself from work) or leisure, i.e. (by implication) a "school" (as vacation from physical employment):--school.
BiblicalUsage: A schole is a school, and Paul's school was the school of one Tyrannus at Ephesus, where he separated the disciples and disputed daily after the synagogue hardened against the way.
TheologicalSignificance: What strikes me is that the gospel found a classroom when the synagogue closed its doors — God always opens another room for His word.
